MAPPO + PAH · Phase 3 · 17 Oct 2026

Settings badlin, PAH aage raha

Phase 3 mein koi nayi training nahi hui. Pehle se train hue 180 models (9 methods × 2 stages × 10 seeds) ko woh imtihan diye gaye jo base papers (DA-MAPPO aur IGAT-MARL) ne apne methods ko diye thay. Har baar sirf ek cheez badli, aur har model ne 200 episodes chalaye.

31/31

Har test setting mein MAPPO + PAH ne Fixed-weight MAPPO ko pakke taur par peeche chhoda. Har jagah 95% CI poori 0 se upar thi. Matlab PAH ka faida sirf ek khaas setting ka kamaal nahi hai.

  • Har line ek test setting hai. Dot = PAH ne Fixed-weight se kitne points zyada success li. Line = 95% CI.
  • Kaali khadi line 0 hai. Agar poori line 0 ke daayein ho to farq pakka hai. Yahan har line daayein hai.
  • Sab se kamzor farq 3 drones par hai (Stage 3: +4.8, CI +0.1 se +9.5). Kam drones ka matlab kam takraav, is liye PAH ke paas karne ko kam hai.

E1

Obstacles zyada karne par

Kya kiya
Wahi trained models, test world mein obstacles 10 se 50 tak barhaye (DA-MAPPO paper ki tarah ENV-1/2/3 = 30/40/50).
Natija
Sab methods girte hain, lekin MAPPO + PAH har density par pehle number par rehta hai.
  • Har line ek method hai. Neeche jaana = success kam. Halka rang wala patta = 95% CI (bharose ki range).
  • Dotted khadi line "trained" woh setting hai jis par model train hua tha. Us se aage sab kuch naya imtihan hai, is liye girna normal hai.
  • Stage 3, 50 obstacles par: MAPPO + PAH 40.4%, Fixed-weight MAPPO 25.7%, DA-MAPPO (2D) 2.7%, MAPPO 2.6%, IPPO 1.9%.

Base paper ke saathDA-MAPPO paper, Table V (30/40/50 obstacles)

  • Dono studies mein obstacles barhne se har method girta hai. Dono mein tarteeb DA-MAPPO > MAPPO > IPPO hai.
  • Seedhe number mat milaiye: paper mein 3 drones aur 3D Gazebo hai, hamare Stage 3 mein 8 drones. Paper ne obstacles ka curriculum (0 se 40) use kiya, hamare models sirf 20 par train hue. Is liye hamara DA-MAPPO (2D) bohat neeche hai.
  • Jo cheez milti hai woh rukh (trend) hai, number nahi.
E2

Ruke hue targets

Kya kiya
Targets ki speed 0 kar di. Models chalte targets (speed 1) par train hue thay.
Natija
Ajeeb natija: lagbhag har method ki success gir gayi. MAPPO + PAH sab se kam gira, aur Fixed-weight se farq barh kar +16.6 ho gaya (Stage 3).
  • Kaala dot = training wali setting (chalte targets). Narangi dot = ruke targets.
  • Number = kitne points gira, aur ▼ ka matlab hai girna pakka hai (CI 0 se neeche).
  • Hamare paas iski test ki hui wajah nahi hai. Thesis mein ise sirf observation ke taur par likhna hai, koi wajah gadhni nahi.

Base paper ke saathDA-MAPPO paper, Table IV (static) aur Table V (dynamic)

  • Paper mein ulta hai: wahan static aasaan hai, aur dynamic targets par MAPPO 21 aur IPPO 28 points girte hain. DA-MAPPO takreeban nahi girta.
  • Farq ki wajah: paper mein "dynamic" ka matlab hai targets beech mission mein jagah badal lete hain. Hamare yahan targets aahista aahista chalte rehte hain, aur hamare models train hi chalte targets par hue thay.
  • Is liye ye do alag tajurbe hain. Number ka ulta hona contradiction nahi hai.
E3

Assignment har 50 steps baad

Kya kiya
Hungarian assignment har step ki jagah sirf har 50 steps baad chalaya (DA-MAPPO ke ablation ki tarah). Sirf test par badla, training par nahi.
Natija
Sab methods thoda girte hain: Stage 2 mein lagbhag 1 point (0.7 se 1.3), Stage 3 mein 1.3 se 3.8 points. Real-time assignment se faida hai, lekin chhota.
  • Kaala aur narangi dot bohat qareeb hain, matlab farq chhota hai.
  • PAH ka Fixed-weight se farq phir bhi pakka hai: +6.6 (Stage 2), +7.7 (Stage 3).
  • Paper ka ablation number ke taur par milta nahi (unhon ne assigned target observation se hi nikaal diya tha, jis se 0% aaya). Is liye yahan comparison graph nahi hai.
E4

Drones ki tadaad 3 se 10

Kya kiya
Wahi models 3, 4 … 10 drones par chalaye (IGAT-MARL paper ki tarah). Sirf woh methods jinka input drones ki ginti par depend nahi karta.
Natija
MAPPO + PAH sab se kam gira (Stage 3: 90.5 se 80.5). IGAT-style MAPPO sab se zyada gira (77.3 se 32.5).
  • Neeli line sab se upar aur sab se seedhi hai. Matlab PAH chhote aur bade, dono qisam ke swarms par chal jata hai, halanke train ek hi size par hua tha.
  • MAPPO, DA-MAPPO (2D) aur IPPO is test mein nahi hain. Woh sab teammates ko dekhte hain, is liye unka input fixed size ka hai aur doosre size par baghair nayi training ke chal hi nahi sakte.
E5

Qareeb se guzarna (IGAT-MARL ka metric)

Kya kiya
Har episode mein gina ke kitni baar do drones 3 collision-radius se zyada qareeb aaye (LoS), aur conflict graph mein kitni lines (edges) bani.
Natija
IGAT-style MAPPO ke drones bohat zyada qareeb aate hain. PAH ka LoS Fixed-weight jitna hi hai, kam nahi.
  • Neeche = mehfooz. Peeli line (IGAT-style) drones barhne ke saath bohat tezi se upar jaati hai.
  • Seedhi baat: PAH ka faida mission poora karne mein hai, kam qareeb guzarne mein nahi. Ye thesis mein saaf likhna hai.
  • LoS takkar nahi hai, sirf qareeb se guzarna hai. Takkar success ke number mein pehle se shamil hai.

Base paper ke saathIGAT-MARL paper, Table 1 (edges, N = 3 se 10)

  • Dono studies mein drones barhne se edges barhte hain.
  • Dono panels ka scale alag hai, kyunke paper aur hum edges alag tareeqe se ginte hain. Sirf shape milaiye.
  • IGAT-MARL paper success ya collision rate report hi nahi karta, is liye success ka comparison mumkin nahi.
E6

Sensor (LiDAR) mein noise

Kya kiya
LiDAR ki doori mein random ghalti (noise) daali: σ = 0.02, 0.05, 0.1 (Stage 3). Training mein noise nahi tha.
Natija
Kisi bhi method par 3 points se zyada asar nahi. PAH ka farq +8.5 se +8.7 par wahi raha.
  • Saari lines takreeban seedhi hain, matlab methods is noise se pareshan nahi hote.

Base paper ke saathDA-MAPPO paper, Table IX (velocity par noise)

  • Paper mein bhi noise se chhota asar aaya: 95% se 90%.
  • Noise alag cheez par daala gaya hai (paper: speed, hum: LiDAR), is liye sirf ye milta hai ke dono mein asar chhota hai.
E7

Faisla karne ka waqt

Kya kiya
Laptop ke 1 CPU thread par naapa ke poore swarm ka ek faisla (decision step) kitne millisecond leta hai, 3 se 10 drones.
Natija
PAH aur Fixed-weight barabar hain (0.04 se 0.05 ms). IGAT-style lagbhag 6 guna slow hai (0.23 se 0.29 ms), phir bhi bohat tez.
  • PAH sirf training mein reward ke liye istemal hota hai, faisla karte waqt nahi. Is liye us ka koi extra waqt nahi lagta.
  • DA-MAPPO paper ne waqt Jetson board par naapa hai aur sirf graph mein diya hai, table mein nahi. Is liye number ka comparison nahi kiya.

Yaad rakhne wali baatein

  • Phase 3 mein koi naya primary claim nahi hai. Ye sab secondary natije hain, aur ye run se pehle hi tay ho gaya tha.
  • Training wali setting ke ilawa har setting ek naya imtihan hai. Is mein sab methods ka girna normal hai.
  • Base paper ke numbers PDF se khud padh kar liye gaye hain (DA-MAPPO: Table IV, V, IX; IGAT-MARL: Table 1). Simulator, drones ki tadaad aur training alag hai, is liye sirf rukh aur tarteeb milayi gayi hai.
  • RMAPPO shamil nahi hai, kyunke woh shared settings par seekh nahi saka tha.
  • Saari tables aur poori report: code/notebooks/v4/04-base-paper-experiments/ (REPORT.md, output/phase3_summary.md).
